'''Terrus''' was a [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] who served as a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[General/Legends|general]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He along, with his [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]] and the [[313th Legion]] were transported from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] by a [[hyperspace warping device]] invented by the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vylagos]].<ref name="The Lost Legion" />
